proposedSkills.name: Project Management
proposedSkills.description: Manages issues, tasks, projects, and team workflows through structured project management — hosted issue trackers or git-native ledgers stored inside the repository — handling state transitions, dependencies, and priority levels across human and agent collaborators.

evidence.notes: MIT-licensed skill from the yylo-skills pack (7 SKILL.md skills, active since Sep 2026). Documents the complete Ledger 0.2.0 task CLI: create/list/search/get/mark/update/archive, dependency management (deps/ready/order), history and receipts, cold archive, cross-project routing, and typed merge orchestration across agent worktrees.

The YYLO CLI that powers the ledger — 59 stars, MIT, pushed daily since Jan 2026, published on npm as @yylo/cli. Orchestrates coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Pi) over the same Kanban/task state the skill drives.
